html:
D166　把两种诊断接入同一运行接口

第 24 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D165-让协作流程有明确的停止点。验证版本为 Node.js 20.19.6、pnpm 10.28.0、Vitest 4.1.12；接口运行于本机 NestJS 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

让同一个工单运行入口支持两种诊断方式。用两张内容相同的工单观察角色实际收到的消息、工具审计和最后的结果，再让另一个班组的人尝试启动运行。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/src/agent/team/team.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/evaluation/team-lab.ts
★ apps/server/test/evaluation/team-route.e2e-spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/agent-runs.controller.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/agent.module.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 10 分钟，知识点 35 分钟，动手 55 分钟，自检与提交 20 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。工作日到 1 小时 40 分先停选做内容，留 20 分钟做必做自检。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D165　什么条件让复核结束？

核对答案

复核接受候选或返回证据不足，两种决定都停止。

D163　工具授权绑定哪些要素？

核对答案

绑定调用人、运行、角色可用的工具名，并核验工单当前归属。

D159　为什么要保留原始观测？

核对答案

出现分歧时可从原始调用和状态重新评分。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 从接口一路核对到模型

请求体只指定 mode。服务端认领运行、组装每次调用的消息并记录轨迹。用捕获的网关入参与持久化快照逐项核对，可以发现轨迹写对了但模型实际收到不同材料的错误。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/evaluation/team-route.e2e-spec.ts -t "保存三次隔离的角色输入并交付复核结果"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/evaluation/team-route.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('保存三次隔离的角色输入并交付复核结果', async () => {
    const { path } = await lab.start('端口丢包。只给分诊看的材料');
    const mock = vi.spyOn(lab.gateway, 'complete').mockResolvedValueOnce(response({ index: 0, needCounts: false }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(response({ category: 'network' })).mockResolvedValueOnce(response({ verdict: 'accept' }));
    const run = await lab.api.post(path + '/team-diagnose').set('authorization', lab.issue('bob')).send({ mode: 'team' }).expect(200);
    expect(run.body.data.stopReason).toBe('answered');
    expect(mock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    for (const ordinal of [2, 3, 4]) {
      const packet = await lab.api.get(path + '/tools/contexts/' + ordinal).set('authorization', lab.issue('bob')).expect(200);
      expect(packet.body.data.messages).toEqual(mock.mock.calls[ordinal - 2][0]);
      if (ordinal > 2) expect(JSON.stringify(packet.body.data.messages)).not.toContain('只给分诊看的材料');
    }
    const events = await lab.api.get(path + '/events').set('authorization', lab.issue('bob'));
    expect(events.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer).toBe('network');
  });

推导题　为什么不能只检查快照里有没有角色名称？

答案

角色名称不能说明实际收到的内容。测试还要比较消息本身，确认诊断拿到选中的证据，复核拿到候选结论。

1.2 先鉴权再认领运行

跨班组账号即使知道运行 ID，也应得到 404。随后用工单所有者读取运行，确认还在原状态，同时核对网关调用数为零。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/evaluation/team-route.e2e-spec.ts -t "无权用户不能触发任何角色或认领该运行"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/evaluation/team-route.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('无权用户不能触发任何角色或认领该运行', async () => {
    const { path } = await lab.start('教学材料');
    const model = vi.spyOn(lab.gateway, 'complete');
    await lab.api.post(path + '/team-diagnose').set('authorization', lab.issue('alice')).send({ mode: 'team' }).expect(404);
    await lab.api.post(path + '/team-diagnose').set('authorization', lab.issue('bob')).send({ mode: 'other' }).expect(400);
    expect(model).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const read = await lab.api.get(path).set('authorization', lab.issue('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(read.body.data.run.status).toBe('queued');
  });

推导题　为什么已经有 404 断言还要查运行状态？

答案

错误响应可能在认领或调用模型之后才发出。检查状态和外部调用才能发现这种副作用。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　接入共用的运行服务

提示一 · 方向

沿原有执行器复用认领、轨迹和停止原因。

提示二 · API

POST /api/agent/runs/:id/team-diagnose，body 取 {mode:"single"} 或 {mode:"team"}。

提示三 · 实现顺序

根据角色生成材料，调用网关，交回结构化决定并保存这步的快照。

步骤 2　验证两种身份

提示一 · 方向

先以同班组用户创建工单，再对同一个运行换跨班组身份。

提示二 · API

从 apps/server 运行本页两个带 -t 的端到端示例。

提示三 · 实现顺序

核对 HTTP 状态、网关调用数和所有者可见的运行状态。

三、自检与提交

提交一次成功响应和一次 404，附两者的模型调用次数以及运行状态。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/team/team.service.ts 把 ...(answer ? { answer } : {}) 临时替为 ...(answer ? { answer: 'unknown' } : {})，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected 'unknown' to be 'network' // Object.is equality

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/agent-runs.controller.ts 把 message: '诊断模式无效' }, 400 临时替为 message: '诊断模式无效' }, 422，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

Error: expected 400 "Bad Request", got 422 "Unprocessable Entity"

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

从 沙箱接口日志 核对两项断言，再解释相同接口怎样接受两种 mode。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D166 提交了”。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

4.1 把两种诊断接入同一运行接口

apps/server/src/agent/team/team.service.ts

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../../auth/auth.types.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../../assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { parseToolReply } from '../../assistant/tool-protocol.js';
import { UsageMeter } from '../../assistant/usage-meter.js';
import { RunExecutorService } from '../run-executor.service.js';
import { TicketToolsService } from '../ticket-tools.service.js';
import type { StepOutcome } from '../run-loop.js';
import { grantRead } from './authority.js';
import { TeamSession, type Mode } from './session.js';

@Injectable()
export class TeamDiagnosisService {
  constructor(private readonly executor: RunExecutorService, private readonly tools: TicketToolsService,
    private readonly gateway: ModelGateway) {}
  execute(user: AuthUser, id: string, mode: Mode) {
    const session = new TeamSession(mode, id);
    return this.executor.execute(user, id, async (step): Promise<StepOutcome> => {
      const action = session.next(), signal = AbortSignal.timeout(step.deadlineMs);
      if (action.kind === 'read') {
        const call = { name: action.name, version: 1, args: {} };
        try {
          const grant = grantRead(action.role, user.id, id, action.name);
          const [result] = await this.tools.batch(user, id, [call], signal, false, grant);
          if (!result?.ok) throw new Error('读取未获准');
          session.accept(result.data);
          return { phase: 'tool', summary: action.name, tokens: 0,
            trace: { kind: 'tool', input: JSON.stringify(call), output: JSON.stringify(result) } };
        } catch { return { phase: 'tool', summary: '读取中止', failure: 'TEAM_READ_FAILED', failureReason: 'tool_failed', tokens: 0 }; }
      }
      // 每一角色使用新消息；保存快照时重新校验运行归属与权限指纹。
      const packet = await this.tools.saveContext(user, id, step.ordinal, action.messages).catch(() => null);
      if (!packet) return { phase: 'plan', summary: '交接中止', failure: 'TEAM_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE', failureReason: 'tool_failed', tokens: 0 };
      const meter = new UsageMeter();
      let output = '', valid = false, answer: string | undefined;
      try {
        const raw = await this.gateway.complete(packet.messages, signal, 'default', Math.min(step.deadlineMs, 5000),
          { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: action.role, strict: true, schema: z.toJSONSchema(action.schema) } }, meter);
        const reply = parseToolReply(raw);
        if (reply.kind !== 'answer') throw new Error('角色答复无效');
        output = reply.text;
        answer = session.accept(JSON.parse(output)); valid = true;
      } catch { /* 已用 token 与失败步骤一起记账。 */ }
      const { inputTokens, outputTokens } = meter.summary();
      return { phase: answer || !valid ? 'answer' : 'plan', summary: action.role, tokens: inputTokens + outputTokens,
        ...(answer ? { answer } : {}), ...(!valid ? { failure: 'TEAM_MODEL_FAILED', failureReason: 'model_failed' as const } : {}),
        trace: { kind: 'model', input: packet.messages.map(m => m.content).join('\n'), output, inputTokens, outputTokens } };
    });
  }
}

apps/server/test/evaluation/team-lab.ts

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../../src/app.setup.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../../src/assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from '../fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from '../auth.js';

export async function openLab(prefix: string) {
  const mod = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile();
  const app = mod.createNestApplication(); configureApp(app); await app.init();
  const db = app.get(PrismaService), api = request(app.getHttpServer()), issue = await tokenIssuer(app);
  const fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, prefix), runs: string[] = [];
  async function start(description: string) {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create();
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { description } });
    const created = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', issue('bob'))
      .send({ ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, goal: '核对现象并给出分类', requestKey: randomUUID() }).expect(201);
    const id: string = created.body.data.id; runs.push(id);
    return { id, ticket, path: '/api/agent/runs/' + id };
  }
  return { db, api, issue, start, gateway: app.get(ModelGateway), close: async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: runs } } }); await fixtures.cleanup(); await app.close();
  } };
}
export type Lab = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof openLab>>;
export function response(value: unknown) {
  return { choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: JSON.stringify(value) } }] };
}

apps/server/src/agent/agent-runs.controller.ts

import { Body, Header, Controller, Get, HttpCode, HttpException, Param, Post, Query, Req, Sse, UseGuards,
  type MessageEvent } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { eventPageSchema, eventViewSchema, runDetailSchema, runListSchema, runStartSchema, runVersionSchema,
  runViewSchema, stepViewSchema, tracePageSchema, traceViewSchema } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { AgentRunsService } from './agent-runs.service.js';
import { AgentJournalService } from './agent-journal.service.js';
import { RunTraceService } from './run-trace.service.js';
import { RunStreamService } from './run-stream.service.js';
import { RunStreamGuard, RunTicketService, type RunStreamRequest } from './run-stream.ticket.js';
import { RawResponse } from '../common/response.interceptor.js';
import { Public } from '../auth/public.decorator.js';
import { TeamDiagnosisService } from './team/team.service.js';
import { DiagnosisService } from './diagnosis.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';
import { RunStateError } from './run-state.js';
import { z } from 'zod';

type RunRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentRunsService['get']>>;
type StepRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['steps']>>[number];
type EventRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['events']>>[number];

export function stepView(step: StepRow) {
  return stepViewSchema.parse({
    id: step.id, ordinal: step.ordinal, phase: step.phase, status: step.status, summary: step.summary,
    errorCode: step.errorCode, startedAt: step.startedAt.toISOString(),
    endedAt: step.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 事件对外只给序号、类型、所属步序和扁平载荷；不暴露内部主键。
export function eventView(event: EventRow, stepOrdinal: number | null) {
  return eventViewSchema.parse({
    seq: event.seq, type: event.type, stepOrdinal,
    payload: event.payload ?? {}, createdAt: event.createdAt.toISOString(),
  });
}

export function runView(run: RunRow) {
  return runViewSchema.parse({
    id: run.id, ticketNo: run.ticketNo, goal: run.goal, status: run.status, stopReason: run.stopReason,
    version: run.version, stepCount: run.stepCount, createdAt: run.createdAt.toISOString(),
    startedAt: run.startedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, endedAt: run.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 输入问题是 400，看不到是 404，权限变化是 403；状态类问题（转移不允许或被别人改过）都是 409。
export function runHttpStatus(code: string, stateError = false) {
  if (stateError) return 409;
  if (code.endsWith('NOT_FOUND')) return 404;
  if (code === 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID') return 400;
  if (code === 'RUN_SCOPE_CHANGED') return 403;
  return 409;
}

function httpError(error: unknown): never {
  if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
  const known = error instanceof RunFailure || error instanceof RunStateError;
  const code = known ? error.code : 'RUN_FAILED';
  throw new HttpException({ code, message: '运行请求未完成，请查看运行状态后再试' },
    known ? runHttpStatus(code, error instanceof RunStateError) : 503);
}

@Controller('agent/runs')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class AgentRunsController {
  constructor(private readonly teamDiagnosis: TeamDiagnosisService, private readonly diagnosis: DiagnosisService, private readonly runs: AgentRunsService, private readonly journal: AgentJournalService,
    private readonly traces: RunTraceService, private readonly streams: RunStreamService,
    private readonly tickets: RunTicketService) {}

  @Post() @HttpCode(201)
  async start(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runStartSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const { run } = await this.runs.start(user, parsed.data);
      return runView(run);
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get()
  async list(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser) {
    try { return runListSchema.parse((await this.runs.list(user)).map(runView)); } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get(':id')
  async detail(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      return runDetailSchema.parse({ run: runView(run), steps: (await this.journal.steps(run.id)).map(stepView) });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 增量拉取：客户端带上已经看到的最大序号，只取后面的事件。
  @Get(':id/events')
  async events(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Query('after') after?: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const parsed = z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).safeParse(after ?? 0);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const steps = await this.journal.steps(run.id);
      const ordinals = new Map(steps.map(step => [step.id, step.ordinal]));
      const events = await this.journal.events(run.id, parsed.data);
      const views = events.map(event => eventView(event, event.stepId ? ordinals.get(event.stepId) ?? null : null));
      return eventPageSchema.parse({ runId: run.id, events: views, lastSeq: views.at(-1)?.seq ?? parsed.data });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // Trace 只给运行的发起人；内容已在写入时脱敏并截断。
  @Get(':id/traces')
  async traceList(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const rows = await this.traces.list(run.id);
      return tracePageSchema.parse({
        runId: run.id,
        traces: rows.map(row => traceViewSchema.parse({
          ordinal: row.ordinal, kind: row.kind, input: row.input, output: row.output,
          inputTokens: row.inputTokens, outputTokens: row.outputTokens,
          durationMs: row.durationMs, truncated: row.truncated,
        })),
        usage: await this.traces.usage(run.id),
      });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 先用已登录的接口换一张短期票据：EventSource 不能带 Authorization 头。
  @Post(':id/stream-ticket') @HttpCode(201)
  async streamTicket(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const parsed = z.object({ after: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0) })
        .strict().safeParse(input ?? {});
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      return await this.tickets.issue(user.id, run.id, parsed.data.after);
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/team-diagnose') @HttpCode(200)
  async compareDiagnosis(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    const parsed = z.object({ mode: z.enum(['single', 'team']) }).strict().safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new HttpException({ code: 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID', message: '诊断模式无效' }, 400);
    try { return runView((await this.teamDiagnosis.execute(user, id, parsed.data.mode)).run); }
    catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/diagnose') @HttpCode(200)
  async diagnose(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    const choice = z.object({ manualId: z.uuid().optional() }).strict().safeParse(input ?? {});
    if (!choice.success) throw new HttpException({ code: 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID', message: '手册编号无效' }, 400);
    try { return runView((await this.diagnosis.execute(user, id, choice.data.manualId)).run); } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/cancel') @HttpCode(200)
  async cancel(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runVersionSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      return runView(await this.runs.cancel(user, id, parsed.data.version));
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 票据在守卫里兑换；本路由不走常规登录态，所以标 Public 并单独鉴权。
  @Public()
  @UseGuards(RunStreamGuard)
  @RawResponse()
  @Header('X-Accel-Buffering', 'no')
  @Sse(':id/stream', { maxPendingDataLength: 64 * 1024 })
  stream(@Req() request: RunStreamRequest): Observable<MessageEvent> {
    const { userId, runId, after } = request.runStream;
    return this.streams.open(userId, runId, after);
  }
}
